# DeepResearch OTLP collector

This maintainer distribution uses the same component releases as the official
0.163.2 collector, retaining the components used by the checked-in configuration:
the OTLP receiver, batch processor, OTLP and OTLP/HTTP exporters, and the env,
file, HTTP, HTTPS and YAML configuration providers. Both traces and logs
pipelines remain supported. The unconfigured contrib component catalogue and
cloud-specific configuration providers are intentionally absent; a future
configuration that needs them requires a new reviewed component selection.

The source is generated by the checksum-verified official Collector Builder.
`manifest.yaml`, the generated Go source and complete Go module locks are
checked in. x/net is fixed at 0.62.0; other versions follow the selected core
components' published module requirements. The image build consumes these
locks in readonly mode. go-jose is absent from the Linux production graph.

`deployment/docker/Dockerfile.otel-collector` preserves the pinned 0.163.2
contrib runtime root and `/otelcol-contrib` entrypoint, replacing its executable
with this smaller distribution. Build information retains real dependency
identities and must show the fixed x/net version and no go-jose module.
The generated main module is `deepresearch/otelcol`, so the build does not
claim upstream contrib source or VCS identity.

The Go 1.27.3 Linux/amd64 production graph resolves offline with readonly locks.
Local registry/GitHub transport failed with TLS errors, so the candidate image
has not been built or its full configuration validated locally. Remote CI must
build and scan the actual image and run `validate` against the complete existing
configuration before this change is considered verified for execution.
